description: Na₄Mg(WO₄)₂ crystallizes in the monoclinic Cm space group. There are three inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.21-2.62 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.24-2.49 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.21-2.62 Å. Mg is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to four O atoms. There are two shorter (2.02 Å) and two longer (2.05 Å) Mg-O bond lengths. There are two inequivalent W sites. In the first W site, W is bonded in a distorted see-saw-like geometry to four O atoms. There are two shorter (1.91 Å) and two longer (1.93 Å) W-O bond lengths. In the second W site, W is bonded in an octahedral geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of W-O bond distances ranging from 1.88-2.30 Å. There are six inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to three Na, one Mg, and one W atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to three Na and two W atoms. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to three Na, one Mg, and one W atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded to three Na and one W atom to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing ONa₃W tetrahedra. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to two Na, one Mg, and one W atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded to three Na and one W atom to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing ONa₃W tetrahedra.
